architecture.mechanism: Friction modifier additives administered via gasoline accumulate in the engine lubricant at concentrations significantly higher than the initial fuel treatment level, enhancing boundary lubrication film strength.
architecture.intervention: Introduce a factory-fill engine oil formulation containing high-concentration friction modifiers chemically identical to those proven to accumulate from fuel, directly addressing the insufficient boundary lubrication that causes catastrophic crankshaft bearing failure during manufacturing and initial run-in.
architecture.expected_effect: The enhanced boundary lubrication film prevents metal-to-metal contact at the crankshaft journal bearings under high-load or low-oil-pressure conditions, eliminating the root cause of catastrophic bearing wear and seizure without relying on ECU software interventions.
architecture.falsification_test: Conduct an accelerated engine dynamometer durability test on factory-filled engines using the modified oil formulation under simulated low-oil-pressure conditions; measure crankshaft bearing clearance and surface roughness after 500 hours to verify absence of bearing material loss compared to baseline production oil.
